main_claim: Donchenko says Ukrainian fighters are ready to fight Russians but the UFC avoids such bouts to dodge online hate, citing the cancelled Poteria vs Magomedov fight.

main_claim: Topuria's essay reflects on his first defeat, to Gaethje, and lists the injuries he left the fight with: both eye orbits fractured, broken septum and foot.
note: His own words 'las dos órbitas de los ojos fracturadas, el tabique y el pie rotos' state his condition inside the essay the article is built on, so fact is health as in the guide's #723 ruling; the loss is retold in a reflection after the fight, not as a fight report, so result is no.

main_claim: Gaethje says Topuria was easy to predict because his footwork never changes rhythm, and explains the game plan that beat him at UFC Freedom 250.

main_claim: Eddie Alvarez says an immediate Gaethje rematch would be a mistake and that Topuria must rebuild confidence against a lesser opponent first.

main_claim: Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but no one has spoken to him about it, lists other possible opponents and hopes to return in December.

No one's spoke to me about it'), with only a recap of the Gaethje loss about Topuria, so only_mentioned per the callout rule, though the framing around a Topuria fight could read as one_of_several; 'growing chatter that the UFC is thinking about' an immediate Gaethje rematch gives no who or when, so no_fact rather than next_fight.

main_claim: Usman Nurmagomedov mocks the UFC lightweight top 10, including Topuria for quitting on his stool against Gaethje, while praising Quillan Salkilld.
note: Topuria is one name in a list of five fighters roasted, and his paragraph only retells the Gaethje loss ('Lost early, sat down on a chair'), so only_mentioned, though the dedicated paragraph could be read as one_of_several; the article frames the remark as a 'dig' and a 'roast', so calls_him_out rather than assesses_him.

main_claim: Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but nothing has been discussed with him, and he hopes to fight again in December against any top name.
note: Pimblett's own stance ('I'd love to smash his head in... Nothing yet. No one's spoke to me about it') is a callout, and what the article says about Topuria (the loss, the orbital fractures, the essay) is all recap, so only_mentioned despite his share of the text; 'rumors swirling that Topuria could make his UFC return against Pimblett' names no source, date or event, so no_fact, but an editor could read it as next_fight at rumour and the long Topuria section as one_of_several.

main_claim: Matt Brown says the UFC risks ruining Topuria's life with an immediate Gaethje rematch and should give him a proper return fight against someone like Moicano.

Moicano, he needs a proper return fight' is sincere advice from a former fighter, so steers_him; the rematch talk is the premise the writer sets up ('UFC commentator Jon Anik claimed that internal conversations are ongoing'), not the article's claim, so no_fact, though because Anik is named an editor could call it next_fight at rumour; the broken orbital bones are recapped background, so health is no.

Bigger, longer, and probably stronger' rates Amosov's level with no fight set ('No timeline exists for that jump or for Amosov earning a title shot'), so assesses_him and no_fact; Makhachev shares the headline, so an editor could pick one_of_several, but the content is about Amosov.

main_claim: Gaethje says he will not fight again in 2026 because of a knee bone bruise and hand injuries, and blames Topuria's loss on emotional mistakes in his preparation.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and that either a Gaethje rematch or a Pimblett fight makes sense for his return, with nothing set yet.

We don't have anything set' is the promotion stating his readiness with Gaethje and Pimblett named only as options, so status_update at official_or_done and next fight no; an editor could count 'the news leaked that the UFC was considering giving the former champ an immediate rematch' as a rumour and answer next fight yes.
